description: Known debt for GATE-numbers: untagged tool-shaped tokens that documents held when the gate was introduced (W0-S11), each keyed by its document, its token and a hash of its sentence. The fast lane reports them and passes; --strict, the release lane, fails on them. A token leaves this list when its sentence gains a run reference, a [D] or a [V] tag, or is rewritten; a changed sentence no longer matches and fails until it is tagged. Regenerate with node scripts/verify-numbers.mjs --write-baseline, and review the diff: the list may only shrink.
